issues.where: data/public/calls/he-cl1-indoorhealth/call.md, Eligibility: 'At least three independent legal entities, each established in a different EU Member State or Associated Country, at least one of them in a Member State.' The same wording appears in call.yaml eligibility.consortium.notes.
issues.problem: The minimum is missing the requirement that these entities participate as beneficiaries. Annex B requires three independent beneficiaries, not merely three participating entities. Affiliated entities and associated partners cannot supply the minimum. As written, an applicant can satisfy the visible wording with two beneficiaries and an independent associated partner in a third eligible country; the real scheme would reject that arrangement. This matters especially to heatstorage-stretch, whose hidden T2 correctly requires beneficiaries although the call never says so.
issues.fix: Replace the eligibility sentence in both files with: 'The consortium must include, as beneficiaries, at least three mutually independent legal entities established in three different EU Member States or Associated Countries, including at least one entity established in a Member State. Affiliated entities and associated partners do not count towards this minimum.' Preserve min_entities: 3 and min_countries: 3.
